entry.title: Heavy Rain Warning - Orange
entry.summary: Expect 60 to 90 mm of rain in addition to what has already fallen, mainly about the ranges. Peak rates of 15 to 25 mm/h. Impact: Streams and rivers may rise rapidly. Surface flooding, slips, and difficult driving conditions possible. Chance of upgrading to a Red Warning: Minimal.
